2.192.30
NumericIndicator.SnappingEnabled
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The NumericIndicator.SnappingEnabled element is ignored if it is present. However, its data type
is validated, and the value MUST be a Boolean ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.2) or an expression that
evaluates to a Boolean.
The following is the parent element of the NumericIndicator.SnappingEnabled element.
Parent elements
NumericIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the NumericIndicator.SnappingEnabled element.
 <xsd:element name="SnappingEnabled" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
